details.description: Nova-2 Phonecall is a Deepgram speech-to-text model in the Nova-2 tier, described by Deepgram's docs as optimized for low-bandwidth audio phone calls. It shares Nova-2's underlying architecture, which Deepgram says improves entity recognition, punctuation, and capitalization over the earlier Nova-1 model through speech-specific Transformer optimizations, advanced data curation, and multi-stage training. It supports English only. Deepgram's separate voicemail-tuned Nova-2 model is derived from this phonecall model.
advantages: Deepgram tunes Nova-2 Phonecall specifically for low-bandwidth audio phone calls.

Deepgram says Nova-2 improves entity recognition (e.g. proper nouns, alphanumerics), punctuation, and capitalization over its Nova-1 predecessor through speech-specific Transformer optimizations, advanced data curation, and multi-stage training.
disadvantages: Supports English only, per Deepgram's language documentation.

Deepgram's current models overview table recommends Nova-2 mainly for languages not yet supported by its newer Nova-3 tier and for filler-word identification, rather than as its default general recommendation.
use_cases: Transcribing low-bandwidth telephone call audio, such as call-center or customer-service recordings, per Deepgram's documentation.

notes: Deepgram's Nova-2 launch article (deepgram.com/learn/nova-2-speech-to-text-api) reports WER figures for the Nova-2 model tested across four generic audio domains including 'phone call', but does not attribute them to this domain-tuned phonecall option specifically, so no evaluation figure is used (WER is also excluded from the evaluations schema). Catalog carries no deprecation_date, consistent with Nova-2 not appearing under Deepgram's 'Legacy Models' heading (Nova 1, Enhanced, Base).
